$comment: Sparse-checkout (cone mode) profiles for `aphrody-bun git profile <name>`. paths are directories (cone mode accepts directories only; top-level files are always checked out). submodules are gitlink paths initialised shallow (--depth 1) after the cone is set; entries ending in /* match every gitlink below that directory. optionalSubmodules get `update = none` in .gitmodules and are only fetched by a profile that lists them.

core.description: Tooling, factory, docs, infra: enough to run the quality gates that read tracked files only.

rust-workspace.description: Cargo workspace members and the path dependencies they reference (crates, vendored crates, pdfcraft, bun-tauri, cubeb-rs).

web.description: Bun workspaces (apps and packages), design system, fonts and the web vendor trees.

kernel-distro.description: Distribution and kernel sources (Linux only): pkgbuilds, kernels, Wine/Proton, LLVM.

vendor-minimal.description: Only the vendored cargo crates and the shallow sources the runtime build links.

all.description: Full checkout: disables sparse-checkout and initialises every non-optional submodule shallow.
